_comment: Isengard curve-following A/B (0.9.7-dev, commit ff5ecfb4 code; binary hash-label lags, string 'curvehop' verified). Tests whether $nav curve fixes the room-36 sewer-corkscrew cluster + the outdoor valley wedging. ONE continuous isengard game (fellowship.mn3 L2, TimeLimit=600 so it never auto-advances off isengard), 16 bots (the density where the cluster formed in the moonshot: ~53 room-36 escalations/hr). gridall+outroute ON throughout so QueryVia runs in room 36 and the outdoor lattice is followed; curve is the A/B variable, alternated in 90-min blocks. Split the log at the '$nav curve on|off' echoes; the metric is room-36 stuck-escalations + via-suspends per hour, curve-on vs curve-off, plus any captures. Grate-destruction drift across the continuous game is averaged by the A/B/A/B alternation and does not touch the room-36 indoor mound.
